parsed.note_claim: Cronobacter sakazakii causes necrotizing enterocolitis in newborns and is deadly.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: C. sakazakii can cause bacteraemia and sepsis, cerebro-spinal and peritoneal fluid accumulation, brain abscesses, cyst formation, necrotizing enterocolitis (NEC), meningitis and intracerebral infarctions.
parsed.reason: The page explicitly confirms that C. sakazakii causes necrotizing enterocolitis and notes it is responsible for up to 80% of infant deaths associated with infection.
